game_title: Code Reading Relay – Camel Trail Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about predicted to power up the oasis keeper and open the caravan wagon.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Camel Trail'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
